patterns: how can i take admission in sdit
could you walk me through the entire admission process step by step
response: Admissions at SDIT are available for B.E, MBA, MCA, and M.Tech programs. For B.E: minimum 45% in PCM at PUC (40% for SC/ST/OBC). For MBA: minimum 50% in bachelor's degree (45% for SC/ST/Cat-I Karnataka). For MCA: minimum 50% in BCA/B.Sc/B.Com/B.A (45% for SC/ST/Cat-I). For M.Tech: minimum 50% in qualifying exam with valid GATE score (45% for SC/ST/Cat-I). Apply online at sdit.ac.in/application-form. CET Code: E146.

response: For B.E admission: a candidate must have passed Pre-University Board or equivalent examination with a minimum of 45% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics. For SC/ST and OBC categories, the minimum is 40%. CET Code: E146.

response: For MBA admission: a candidate must have a Bachelor's Degree (minimum 3 years) with an aggregate minimum of 50% marks in all subjects including languages. For SC, ST and Category-I Karnataka candidates, the minimum is 45%. PGCET Code: B281.

response: For MCA admission: candidates must have passed BCA, B.E in Computer Science, or equivalent, or B.Sc/B.Com/B.A preferably with Mathematics, with an aggregate minimum of 50% marks. Students without Mathematics background must complete bridge courses as notified by the university. For SC/ST/Category-I Karnataka candidates, the minimum is 45%. PGCET Code: C476.

patterns: what documents are needed for admission

what papers do i need to bring for admission
response: Documents required for B.E admission: Original SSLC (Secondary School Leaving Certificate), Original PUC (Pre-University Certificate), Photocopy of Aadhaar Card, Original Transfer Certificate (TC) and Conduct Certificate, Passport size photograph, and Migration Certificate (for non-Karnataka students). For PG programs (MBA/MCA/M.Tech): additionally, original undergraduate degree marks cards and provisional course clearance certificate.
